title: DACY: A UNIFIED FRAMEWORK FOR DANISH NLP

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual data augmentation by substituting person entities (PER) in the DaNE test set with randomly sampled names of Muslim origin used in Denmark, and comparing model performance (NER, POS, and dependency parsing) against a baseline of traditional Danish names.

Counterfactual data augmentation by substituting person entities (PER) in the DaNE test set with randomly sampled Danish male and female names to evaluate and compare performance discrepancies across genders.
